manifest.name: dsh-subagent-cursor
manifest.description: Cursor CLI one-shot subagent provider for DSH: spawns cursor-agent in the Session workspace and returns its single authoritative answer

bundle.text:
# Cursor CLI subagent provider.
#
# One entry only: this plugin registers BOTH the provider (on ctx.subagents as
# "cursor") and its own model-facing tool (subagent_cursor). It deliberately does
# not mount @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent, which only publishes its tool when it
# observes the provider at its own install time or through a later
# `subagent/provider-added` event — a race a sibling insert in the same layer can
# lose, leaving the tool silently absent.
- insert:
    - id: subagent-cursor
      name: dsh-subagent-cursor
      # config:
      #   providerName: cursor               # registry name on ctx.subagents; change it for a second instance
      #   toolName: subagent_cursor          # name of the registered tool; must differ per instance
      #   model: cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast   # omit to use the CLI default
      #   permissionMode: trust              # trust | yolo | plan | ask | safe (safe = macOS/Linux only)
      #   approveMcps: true                  # pass --approve-mcps (independent of permissionMode)
      #   env: {}                            # explicit child env entries, e.g. { CURSOR_INVOKED_AS: cursor-agent }
      #   extraArgs: []                      # escape hatch: appended verbatim before the prompt (unvalidated)
      #   disposeGraceMs: 3000               # grace between termination tiers (positive finite number)
      #   cliPath: C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\cursor-agent\versions\<ver>\index.js

readme.text:
---
description: "面向用户与维护者的 Cursor CLI 一次性 subagent 提供方：把 cursor-agent 作为 DSH 子智能体挂进 Profile，配置权限档、排障与安全边界。"
kind: "package-bundle"
---

**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

把 [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli)（`cursor-agent`）作为 DSH 子智能体提供方：每次委派在父会话的工作区里 spawn 一个全新的 `cursor-agent` 进程，跑完一个任务，只返回它的单条权威答案。

- [为什么需要它](#why) - [使用本包](#use-this-package) - [前提条件](#prerequisites) - [配置](#configuration) - [权限档对照](#permission-modes) - [你会得到什么](#what-you-get) - [踩坑必读](#pitfalls) - [与官方 codex 提供方的差异](#vs-codex) - [理解实现](#understand-the-implementation) - [开发与测试](#development) - [已知限制](#known-limitations) -----

DSH 官方提供两个子智能体后端：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`（Codex）和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code`（Claude Code）。**没有 Cursor。** 而 Cursor CLI 是一个值得接进来的后端：它用的是 Cursor 订阅额度，跑的是真实的 agent 循环（读写文件、跑命令、调 MCP），启动和鉴权都走 `cursor-agent` 自己的配置。装上这个包，模型就能用 `subagent_cursor` 把一段重活丢给 Cursor 去跑，父会话只收一条结论，token 不随上下文线性膨胀。 如果你已经有 Cursor 订阅，这个包让你不必额外买 API key 就能多一个能真正干活的委派后端。 -----

readme.section: 1. 装 Cursor CLI 并登录
readme.text: 见[前提条件](#prerequisites)。这一步不做完，插件装上也不会跑起来。

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm install
```

然后重启 DSH。安装器提示需要重启时必须重启。

本包的 `cordis.patch.yml` 只插入**一行**——这个插件同时注册 provider 和它自己的工具：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: subagent-cursor
      name: dsh-subagent-cursor
```

> **为什么不用官方的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`**：它在 `install` 时通过 `ctx.subagents.getProvider('cursor')` 找 provider，找不到就等 `subagent/provider-added` 事件。当 provider 和它是同层兄弟行时，两条路都可能错过，结果是**工具静默缺席**（只记一条 info 日志，不报错）。自己注册工具就没有这个时序依赖。细节见 [spec §14](./spec/20261030-cursor-subagent-design.md#14-架构修订插件自己注册工具v1-方案被推翻)。

让模型调一次最小任务。期望：拿到一段文本（例如 `OK`），`stopReason` 为 `completed`。

```
用一个 subagent_cursor 任务，只回答 OK，不要调用任何工具。
```

不放心就先跑一条命令行自检，绕开 DSH 只测 CLI：

```bash
node "$LOCALAPPDATA/cursor-agent/versions/<版本>/node.exe" \
     "$LOCALAPPDATA/cursor-agent/versions/<版本>/index.js" \
     -p --output-format stream-json --trust --approve-mcps "Reply with exactly: PONG"
```
`<版本>` 取 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\versions\` 下最新目录名（本机实测写作时的最新是 `2026.10.22-27dcf5f`）。这条命令等价于插件默认档 `trust` + `approveMcps: true` 生成的 argv，能跑通就说明 CLI 侧的鉴权和模型选择都没问题。

`subagent_cursor` 由本插件自己用 `ctx.tools.register()` 注册（不依赖 `dsh-tool-subagent`）。它是 Host 级全局工具，所有 Agent 可见。工具名可用配置项 `toolName` 改；同机挂两套 Cursor 实例时 `providerName` 与 `toolName` 都要改——前者区分 provider，后者区分工具，两个实例共用一个工具名会互相抢占。 工具接受任务后返回 child id；任务完成后把答案作为通知送回父 agent。**这是一次性委派：后端不接受追问**（工具描述原文：*This backend is single-shot: the agent cannot be steered while running and its conversation cannot be continued afterwards.*）。要接着追问，就在新的委派里把必要上下文重新写进 prompt。 -----

1. **已登录 Cursor CLI。** 插件不复用 DSH 的凭据，也不读 `CURSOR_API_KEY`；它只依赖 `cursor-agent` 自己的登录态。先登录：

```bash
   cursor-agent login
   ```

2. **自检通过。** 下面这条应当打印已登录账号（本机实测输出 `✓ Logged in as <你的邮箱>`）：

```bash
   cursor-agent status
   ```

在 Windows 上如果 `cursor-agent` 不在 `PATH`，用 §5 的 `node.exe index.js` 形式：`... index.js status`。

3. **CLI 装在默认位置，或配好 `cliPath`。** 默认位置是 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\`，插件会自己按版本目录名挑最新的一版。装在别处（或想锁定某一版）就配 `cliPath`。

4. **Node.js ≥ 22**（`package.json` 的 `engines`）。实际执行用的是 Cursor CLI 自带打包的 `node.exe`，宿主 Node 只用于加载插件。 5. **模型可用。** 不配 `model` 时用 CLI 默认/账号设置。要固定模型就先确认它在你的账号下存在： ```bash cursor-agent models ``` 配了不存在的模型，CLI 会在 stderr 打出 `Cannot use this model: ... Available models: ...` 然后失败。 > 版本参考：本包实测基线是 Cursor CLI `2026.10.22-27dcf5f`。CLI 的 `stream-json` 输出**没有版本化的契约承诺**，解析器按"宽容 + 可诊断"实现；换版本后建议重跑一次验证步骤。 -----

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `cursor` | `ctx.subagents` 上的注册名。同一台机器挂两套 Cursor（比如一套 `trust`、一套 `plan`）时改它区分 |
| `model` | 省略 | 固定的 CLI 模型 id（非空字符串）。省略则不传 `--model`，由 CLI 默认/账号设置决定 |
| `env` | `{}` | 显式子进程环境条目，叠在共享 subprocess seam 已清洗过的父环境之上 |
| `permissionMode` | `trust` | 非交互权限档，五选一，见[权限档对照](#permission-modes) |
| `approveMcps` | `true` | 为真时加 `--approve-mcps`，自动批准已配置的 MCP server。**独立开关，与 `permissionMode` 正交** |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | 逃生舱：原样追加到 argv 里（prompt 之前）。**不做任何校验**，见下方警告 |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | 分级终止之间的宽限毫秒数。必须是正的有限数，且不超过 timer 上界 |
| `toolName` | `subagent_cursor` | 本插件自己注册的工具名（Host 级全局）。同机挂两套实例时**必须各不相同**（见[暴露的工具](#exposing-the-tool)） |
| `cliPath` | 省略 | 显式 CLI 入口：一个 `index.js` 路径，或含 `index.js` + `node.exe` 的目录。省略则自动发现最新版本 |

`permissionMode` 与 `approveMcps` **不能混为一谈**：`--force`（`yolo` 档）覆盖的是 shell 与文件编辑，**不覆盖第三方 MCP server**。所以 MCP 自动批准是一个独立布尔量，不在任何权限档里。 > **`extraArgs` 警告**：这里传进去的东西不经过任何校验，直接进 argv。不要传会改变输出格式的 flag（例如换 `--output-format`），否则解析器拿不到 `result` 事件，运行必然失败。也不要把 prompt 塞进 `extraArgs`——prompt 是最后一个位置参数，插件自己会追加。 `disposeGraceMs` 在加载期就被校验：非正数、非有限数或超过上界都会让插件加载失败，而不是留到销毁时才出问题。

本提供方的能力标志**全部为 false**：`agentOptions`、`agentPreset`、`outputSchema`、`depthLimit` 都不支持。原因很直接——子进程在另一个进程里，无法兑现父级强制的能力；共享服务会在 `start` 之前就拒绝需要这些能力的请求（不是"接了再忽略"）。 因此深度治理由本插件自己拥有：`startActivation` 的 `request` 里**不传** `maxDepth`，provider 也不接受父级下发的深度上限。如果你需要限制 Cursor 子任务的嵌套，只能靠 prompt 约束或在 CLI 侧限制。 同理，Cursor 是单文本入口，没有"传 schema""传工具白名单""传 persona"的原生通道。这些约束只能写在 prompt 里，属于 prompt 工程，不算 provider 能力。 -----

五个取值，互斥枚举（不允许自由组合，因为组合语义未验证）。`--trust` 是每一档都带的 base flag，所以 `trust` 档**不额外追加**任何 flag。

| `permissionMode` | 追加的 CLI 参数 | 平台 / 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `trust`（默认） | 无（只有 base 的 `--trust`） | 全平台可用。工作区写操作**自动放行** |
| `safe` | `--sandbox enabled` | **仅 macOS / Linux**。Windows 上 CLI exit 1 且 stdout 全空，插件在 `start()` 期就报错 |
| `yolo` | `--force` | 全放行，含 shell / 命令 |
| `plan` | `--mode plan` | 只读 / 规划 |
| `ask` | `--mode ask` | 只读问答 |

readme.section: 为什么默认是 `trust` 而不是 `safe`
readme.text:
这是实测结论，不是口味选择。Windows 上三档真跑一次「创建文件并写入 OK」：

| 档位 | 参数 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `trust` | `--trust` | **22.8s，exit 0，文件真的被写了**，`is_error: false`，正常 `result` 事件 |
| `yolo` | `--trust --force` | 23.2s，exit 0，文件被写，正常 |
| `safe` | `--trust --sandbox enabled` | **2.6s，exit 1，stdout 完全空、零 `result` 事件** |

`safe` 的 stderr 是：`Error: Sandbox mode is enabled but not available on this system. Sandbox requires macOS or Linux.`

readme.section: 为什么默认是 `trust` 而不是 `safe`
readme.text: 结论：**`safe` 在 Windows 上 100% 起不来**。如果默认给 `safe`，这台机器上每一次委派都会失败。能跑的默认值胜过名义上更严但永远跑不起来的默认值。

只改默认值还不够——用户仍可能显式配 `safe` 跑在 Windows 上。不拦的话，子进程会跑 2.6 秒、吐一个空 stdout，然后被记成一句泛泛的 `child run failed (error)`，根本看不出是"沙箱不可用"这种配置问题。 所以插件在 **`start()` 期、spawn 之前**就做平台守卫并抛错，错误消息直接说明 `safe` 仅 macOS/Linux 并给出替代档位（`trust` / `yolo` / `plan` / `ask`）。零进程开销、即时失败、错误可读。 > **未验证**：`safe` 在 macOS / Linux 上按 CLI 报错文案应当可用，但我们**没有在这两个平台上实测过**。要用请自建验证：跑一次带文件写入的任务，确认 `stopReason` 为 `completed` 且文件确实落了盘。 -----

完成通知里是 Cursor 给出的最终答案文本，或者停止原因加一段安全的诊断。 **进父会话的**：最终答案（或失败诊断）。 **不进父会话的**：Cursor 的中间 `assistant` 消息、`thinking` 推理、工具调用事件、原始 stderr、token 用量、工作区 diff。 这一点是有意的：`assistant` 事件只是中间消息，一次运行可能出现多条，拼起来会把模型的思考过程当答案交回去。详见[踩坑必读第 5 条](#pitfalls)。 -----
以下都是拿真机实测换来的，写 prompt 或排障前先读。

readme.section: 1. prompt 必须以祈使指令开头
readme.text:
实测三组 prompt 结构的工具调用次数：

| prompt 结构 | 长度 | 工具调用 |
|---|---|---|
| 只有核心指令 | 138 | **78 次** |
| 核心指令在前 + 约束在后 | 394 | **92 次** |
| **「工作目录：xxx」放在最前** | 443 | **0 次** |

把路径 / 环境说明放在最前面，agent 会把它当成环境交代，回一句「已确认工作目录」就结束了，一个工具都不调。

**对本插件的含义**：模型写 `subagent_cursor` 的 task 时，**第一句必须是祈使句**（"读取 X 并总结""在 Y 里创建 Z"）。工作目录、日期、时区、仓库根这类上下文一律放在指令**之后**。插件不会替你重排 prompt —— 它按原样传给 CLI，顺序变了就是调用方写错了。

另外，子进程的 cwd 已经由 `request.cwd` 决定，**不要在 prompt 里重复交代工作目录**，那正是触发上面那个 0 次退化的写法。

`stream-json` 里统计工具调用要看 `"type": "tool_call"`，subtype 是 `started` / `completed`。早期误用 `tool_use` 统计，把一次成功运行误判成 0 次工具调用。

**对本插件的含义**：你自己写脚本解析 CLI 输出、或排查"它到底动没动手"时，按 `tool_call` 数。插件的解析器（[`src/wire.js`](src/wire.js)）也是按 `tool_call` 计数，并且只计入这两个已知 subtype，不猜。

readme.section: 3. 终端中文乱码的根因在消费端，不是 CLI
readme.text:
**实测：CLI 输出是合法的 UTF-8。** 乱码来自消费端按 GBK 解码——Windows 控制台的默认代码页是 936，把 UTF-8 字节按 GBK 读就成了乱码。

**对本插件的含义**：插件用 `StringDecoder('utf8')` **按块**解码 stdout（[`src/wire.js`](src/wire.js)），不是 `chunk.toString()`。这一点很关键：一次 UTF-8 序列可能被 chunk 边界切断，逐块 `toString()` 会产生替换字符，`StringDecoder` 会把不完整的尾字节留到下一块再拼。

**对你自测的含义**：用 PowerShell 手跑 CLI 看到中文乱码时，别急着怪 CLI；那只是控制台代码页。要干净地看输出，重定向到文件再用 UTF-8 读，或在 PowerShell 里设 `$OutputEncoding` / `[Console]::OutputEncoding` 为 UTF-8。

readme.section: 4. Windows 上 `cursor-agent` 是三层包装，插件绕开它
readme.text:
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\cursor-agent.cmd` 只是转调 `powershell.exe`，PowerShell 再调 `versions\<最新>\node.exe` 跑 `versions\<最新>\index.js`。即 `.cmd` → PowerShell → `node.exe` 三层。

**本插件的做法：直接 spawn `node.exe index.js`。**

- 绝不 spawn `.cmd`：Node 不加 `shell: true` 根本执行不了 `.cmd`。
- 绝不用 `shell: true`：那会把 prompt 丢回 `cmd.exe`，`%VAR%` 会被展开，`&`、`|` 会被当命令分隔符——中文和空格 prompt 尤其危险。

readme.section: 4. Windows 上 `cursor-agent` 是三层包装，插件绕开它
readme.text:
顺带的好处是省掉 PowerShell 启动（每次约 300–800 ms）、没有引号地狱、argv 原样传递。版本目录解析复刻了 `cursor-agent.ps1` 的规则：目录名匹配 `^\d{4}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}(-\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})?-[a-f0-9]+$`，按日期段降序取最新。

注意：`C:\Program Files\cursor\...\cursor` 是 **IDE 启动器，不是 CLI agent**，别指到那里去。

一次运行里 `assistant` 事件有多条（实测一次"ls → pwd → 总结"的运行有 3 条，另一类运行出现过 8 条），`result` 只有 1 条。实测 `result.result` 恰好等于全部 `assistant` 文本按空串拼接。

所以：

- 只取最后一条 `assistant`，会丢掉前面的内容（上面那例丢了 22%）。
- 把 `assistant` 事件拼起来当答案，会把思考过程（"先执行 ls，完成后执行 pwd"）掺进结论里。

**本插件的做法：`output` 只由 `result.result` 构成。** `assistant`、`thinking`、`user` 事件一律不参与答案构造。`result` 缺失（进程被杀等）时不会退回到 thinking 文本——宁可报 `error`，也不吐半成品推理。

**对你排障的含义**：自己写脚本时，只看 `result` 那一行。

- **prompt 走命令行位置参数，受长度上限约束。** Windows 上大约 32 KB。超长 prompt 会**直接失败，而不是被静默截断**——这比截断好，但把大段材料写进文件再让 Cursor 去读，别塞进 prompt。 - **`plan` / `ask` 是只读的。** 别指望 `plan` 档干活。 - **冷启动慢。** CLI 冷启动实测 3~6 s，但 `start()` **不等**这段——spawn 成功即发布 run，冷启动体现在拿到 `result` 的延迟上。超时要按这个量级算。 - **每次委派有约 10K input token 的地板价**（实测 9880 / 9883 等固定开销）。很短的任务用 Cursor 不划算。 -----

readme.section: 与官方 codex 提供方的差异
readme.text:
| 维度 | `dsh-subagent-codex` | 本包（cursor） |
|---|---|---|
| 进程/协议模型 | Codex app-server，JSON-RPC **双向**（要回审批请求） | Cursor CLI `stream-json` NDJSON，**单向**（stdout 只往下流） |
| 握手 | `initialize` → `initialized` → `thread/start` | 无握手；`system`/`init` 只是元数据事件，**不设 ready 门**（spawn 成功即发布 run） |
| 答案选取 | final → partial → 末条无 phase 消息 | **只认 `result.result`**，无回退链 |
| 能力标志 | 全 false | 全 false（同） |
| 人在环审批 | 逐次请求，可 decline / cancel | **没有**请求通道；启动时一次性定死（`--trust` / `--force` / `--approve-mcps`） |
| 中途 steering | 有 interrupt | **没有**，只有 kill 进程 |
| 续接 / resume | 不支持 | 不支持（CLI 有 `--resume`，但本插件不实现 `resume`） |
| 冷启动 | 几百 ms | **3~6 s**（实测 4.4s / 5.8s / 3.2s） |
| 单次 token 地板 | 小 | **约 10K input tokens** |
| 子进程入口 | 随包的平台载荷 | **外部安装的 `cursor-agent`**（不随包分发） |

readme.section: 与官方 codex 提供方的差异
readme.text: 一句话：codex 走的是双向协议、能做逐次审批；cursor 走的是单向事件流、审批全部前置到启动参数。后者更粗，但无人值守场景下反而更简单——不存在"没人回答审批请求导致挂死"这种失败模式。 -----

<details>
<summary>实现细节——点击展开</summary>

- **一次委派 = 一个进程 = 一个 chat。** 每次运行 spawn 全新 `cursor-agent`，跑完一个 prompt 就退出。没有续接、恢复、池化。
- **原生配置是权威。** 登录态、模型默认值、MCP 配置都来自 Cursor CLI 自己的设置。插件只覆盖可选 `model`、显式 `env`、权限档与 MCP 自动批准。
- **刻意无人值守。** CLI 单向输出、stdin 关闭，没有回话通道。所有授权在启动前一次性定死。
- **失败要 loud。** 能在启动期判定的配置错误（CLI 缺失、平台不支持某权限档、cwd 不可用）一律在 `start()` 抛错，绝不拖到运行期用一句通用错误掩盖。

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| [`src/index.js`](src/index.js) | 插件入口：`name` / `inject` / `Config` schema / `CursorProvider` 类 / `apply`（注册 provider 与工具）/ Windows 平台守卫 |
| [`src/tool.js`](src/tool.js) | `subagent_cursor` 工具定义：`defineTool` 参数与输出契约 + `startActivation` 调用 |
| [`src/argv.js`](src/argv.js) | CLI 定位（版本目录解析）+ `buildArgv` + `permissionArgs`（权限档 → CLI flag） |
| [`src/run.js`](src/run.js) | 运行生命周期：spawn → 读流 → 等终态 → `settleRunResult` → 销毁 |
| [`src/wire.js`](src/wire.js) | `CursorStreamReader`：NDJSON 行解析、UTF-8 分块解码、答案选取、诊断摘要 |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) | 插入单个 bundle 行（provider 与工具都由本插件自己注册） |
| [`locale/zh.json`](locale/zh.json) · [`locale/en.json`](locale/en.json) | 插件页显示名与描述 |
| [`tests/`](tests/) | 单测：`argv` / `wire` / `run` / `index` 四组（见[开发与测试](#development)） |

1. **校验与定位。** `start()` 先 `assertUsableCwd` 校验 `request.cwd`，再做平台守卫（`safe` + `win32` 直接抛错），然后 `resolveCursorCli` 定位 `node.exe` + `index.js`（优先级：`cliPath` → `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\{index.js,node.exe}` → `versions\<最新>\{index.js,node.exe}`）。
2. **拼 argv。** `buildArgv` 组装固定顺序：

```
   node.exe index.js -p --output-format stream-json --trust [--model m] [<权限档 flag>] [--approve-mcps] [<extraArgs>] <prompt>
   ```

prompt 永远是最后一个位置参数，其后不能有任何 flag（否则会被当成 prompt 的一部分而不是 flag）。实测默认档的 argv 是：

```json
   ["-p","--output-format","stream-json","--trust","--approve-mcps","Reply with exactly: PONG"]
   ```

3. **spawn。** 经共享 `ctx.subprocess.spawn` 起子进程，`stdio.stdin = 'ignore'`（prompt 是位置参数，stdin 保持关闭，同时避免 CLI 阻塞在一个永远不会有人写的管道上），`cwd` 取 `request.cwd`，`env` 是 seam 清洗过的父环境叠加显式 `env`。spawn 之后先校验 seam 返回的 handle 形状（`stdout`/`stderr`/`done`/`terminate`/`waitForExit`），不符合就 loud 报错并尽力清理。子进程 stderr 原样转发到宿主 stderr（`process.stderr.write`，遇到背压就 pause/resume），同时只滚存末 8 KiB 供失败诊断。
4. **读 NDJSON。** stdout 按块喂给 `CursorStreamReader`，`StringDecoder` 负责跨块的 UTF-8 拼接，按 `\n` 切行、逐行 `JSON.parse`。不是 JSON 对象的行记成噪音跳过（CLI 会往 stdout 混横幅和进度文本），最多留 5 条供失败诊断，不致命；单行无换行且超过 8 MiB 则判流 framing 失败。stdout `'end'` 时还会调 `reader.end()` 收尾，让没有尾换行的最后一行（尤其最后那条 `result`）也能解析。
5. **只取 `result.result`。** 收到 `result` 事件即算终态。`is_error: true` 判失败；答案为空（或全空白）也判失败。第二个 `result` 事件视为流畸形，保留**第一条**，让结果稳定。
6. **销毁。** `requestCancel()` 先触发，然后 `terminate()` 终止托管进程组、等退出、等 `done`，最后 `reader.end()` 并摘掉流监听。失败诊断里会带退出码、信号、`result` 事件数与事件类型集合、stderr 摘录（头 1 KiB + 尾 1 KiB，剥 ANSI）和最多 5 条 stdout 噪音行，但**绝不带答案正文**。
启动期失败（CLI 找不到、cwd 不可用、spawn 抛错、平台守卫）**直接 throw，不发布 run**；发布之后的失败全部折叠成 `stopReason` 与安全诊断。 -----

单测用 Node.js 内置 test runner，不需要构建，也不需要真正的 Cursor CLI：DSH 运行时包由 `tests/_support/hooks.mjs` 的模块解析钩子顶替，子进程用假 `child`（`PassThrough` 流 + thenable `done`）代替，时间只推进微任务，不 sleep、不联网。

```bash
npm test                              # 运行 package.json 的 test script（Node 内置 test runner）
node --test "tests/**/*.test.mjs"     # 等价：直接调用 runner
```

四组文件：`argv.test.mjs`（CLI 定位与 argv 顺序）、`wire.test.mjs`（NDJSON 解析与分块 UTF-8）、`run.test.mjs`（运行生命周期与失败折叠）、`index.test.mjs`（Config 默认值、win32 守卫、provider/工具注册）。当前基线：**114 个用例全部通过**。 > 本仓库**没有 CI workflow**：peer 依赖是私有的 `@deepseek-ai` 包，托管 CI 上 `npm ci` 装不起来；测试只在本地跑（`npm test`）。 -----

- **一次委派 = 一个进程 = 一个 chat。** 没有续接、恢复、池化，也不复用 chat id。工具描述已经如实写明单发模型：不能中途 steering，也不能在同一 chat 上继续。
- **没有中途 steering。** CLI 的 `--print` 模式没有输入通道（stdout 单向、stdin 关闭），所以不实现 `sendMessage`。取消是终止式的：只能 kill 进程。
- **子级 token 不进父会话。** 父会话只收到最终答案或失败诊断；中间消息、thinking、工具活动、stderr、用量、工作区 diff 都不复制过来。子级自己的 token 成本由它自己承担。
- **取消/失败后已改的文件不回滚。** 没有副作用回滚，也没有按实际经过时间触发的超时。`trust` / `yolo` 档下 Cursor 可能真的写过文件、跑过命令——那些都不恢复原状。
- **不支持 `outputSchema` / `agentPreset` / `agentOptions` / `depthLimit`。** 能力标志全 false，请求这些能力会在 `start` 前被共享服务拒绝。
- **CLI 必须外部安装。** 本包不随附 Cursor CLI，也没有"回退到宿主 CLI"这回事。CLI 缺失是启动期错误，会指出试过的路径。
- **prompt 受命令行长度上限约束。** 约 32 KB（Windows）。超长会直接失败而不是截断。
- **stdout 单行有 8 MiB 上限。** 解析器拒绝无限缓冲一条无换行的行（`MAX_LINE_CHARS`）；超限判 `stream framing failed` → `stopReason: error`。正常事件行远小于该值，纯属防御。
- **每次委派约 10K input token 起步，冷启动 3~6 s。** 短任务不划算。
- **`stream-json` 无版本化契约。** 解析器按宽容实现，但 CLI 大改版后仍可能需要跟着改。实测基线 `2026.10.22-27dcf5f`。
- **`safe` 档未在 macOS / Linux 实测。** 按 CLI 报错文案应当可用，未验证。

---
description: "The one-shot Cursor CLI subagent provider for users and maintainers mounting cursor-agent into a Profile: permission modes, troubleshooting, and safety boundaries."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

[简体中文](README.md) · English

Run the [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli) (`cursor-agent`) as a DSH subagent provider. Every delegation spawns a fresh `cursor-agent` process in the parent Session's workspace, runs one self-contained task, and returns only that run's single authoritative answer.

- [Why this package exists](#why) - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Prerequisites](#prerequisites) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Permission modes](#permission-modes) - [What you get](#what-you-get) - [Pitfalls you must read](#pitfalls) - [Differences from the official Codex provider](#vs-codex) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Development and testing](#development) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) -----
DSH ships two official subagent backends: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` (Codex) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code` (Claude Code). Neither speaks to Cursor.

The Cursor CLI is a good backend to add. It runs on a Cursor subscription rather than a separately purchased API key, it is a genuine agent loop (reads and writes files, runs commands, calls MCP servers), and it uses its own login and settings. With this package, a parent model can hand a heavy task to Cursor through `subagent_cursor` and receive one conclusion back, instead of paying for the whole detour in its own context. -----

readme.section: 1. Install and log in to the Cursor CLI
readme.text: See [Prerequisites](#prerequisites). The plugin cannot run a delegation until this is done.

readme.section: 2. Add the dependency to the Profile

readme.text:
```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm install
```

Then restart DSH. If the installer reports that a restart is required, restart.

The package's `cordis.patch.yml` inserts a **single** row — this plugin registers both the provider and its own tool:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: subagent-cursor
      name: dsh-subagent-cursor
```

> **Why not the stock `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`**: at install time it looks the provider up with `ctx.subagents.getProvider('cursor')` and otherwise waits for a `subagent/provider-added` event. When the provider lives in a sibling row of the same layer, both paths can miss it, and the tool then silently fails to appear (only an info-level log, no error). Owning the registration removes that ordering dependency. See [spec §14](./spec/20261030-cursor-subagent-design.md#14-架构修订插件自己注册工具v1-方案被推翻).

Ask the model for a minimal delegation. Expect a text answer (for example `OK`) with `stopReason: completed`.

```
Run one subagent_cursor task that replies only with OK and calls no tools.
```

To test the CLI alone, outside DSH, run the same argument vector the plugin builds for its default mode:

```bash
node "$LOCALAPPDATA/cursor-agent/versions/<version>/node.exe" \
     "$LOCALAPPDATA/cursor-agent/versions/<version>/index.js" \
     -p --output-format stream-json --trust --approve-mcps "Reply with exactly: PONG"
```

`<version>` is the newest directory under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\versions\` (written as `2026.10.22-27dcf5f` on the machine this was measured on). If this returns a `result` event, the CLI side of authentication and model selection is fine.

`subagent_cursor` is registered by this plugin itself via `ctx.tools.register()` (no dependency on `dsh-tool-subagent`). It is a Host-level global tool visible to every Agent. Rename it with the `toolName` config option; when mounting two Cursor instances side by side, change **both** `providerName` and `toolName` — the former distinguishes the provider, the latter the tool, and two instances sharing one tool name contend with each other.

The tool accepts a task and returns a child id; when the task finishes, the answer arrives as a notification to the parent agent. **This is a single-shot delegation: the backend does not accept follow-up messages** (tool description verbatim: *This backend is single-shot: the agent cannot be steered while running and its conversation cannot be continued afterwards.*). To continue a line of work, start a new delegation and restate the context the child needs. -----

1. **Logged in to the Cursor CLI.** The plugin does not reuse DSH credentials and does not read `CURSOR_API_KEY`; it depends entirely on `cursor-agent`'s own login state.

```bash
   cursor-agent login
   ```

2. **A passing self-check.** This should print the signed-in account (measured output: `✓ Logged in as <your email>`):

```bash
   cursor-agent status
   ```

If `cursor-agent` is not on `PATH` on Windows, use the `node.exe index.js` form from step 5: `... index.js status`.

3. **The CLI in its default location, or `cliPath` configured.** The default is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\`, where the plugin selects the newest version directory itself. Install elsewhere, or want to pin one version, and set `cliPath`.

4. **Node.js ≥ 22** (the `engines` field). The child actually runs on the Node binary bundled with the Cursor CLI; the host Node only loads the plugin.

5. **A model your account can use.** Omit `model` to take the CLI default or account setting. To pin one, confirm it exists first:

```bash
   cursor-agent models
   ```

Naming a model that does not exist fails with `Cannot use this model: ... Available models: ...` on stderr.

> Version baseline: this package was measured against Cursor CLI `2026.10.22-27dcf5f`. The CLI publishes **no versioned contract** for its `stream-json` output, so the parser is written to be tolerant and diagnostic. Re-run the verification step after a CLI upgrade. -----
[`src/index.js`](src/index.js)'s `Config` is the single source of truth for these fields.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | `cursor` | Registry name on `ctx.subagents`. Change it to mount two Cursor instances side by side (for example one `trust` and one `plan`) |
| `model` | omitted | Non-empty CLI model id fixed for this instance. Omitted means no `--model`, leaving the CLI default or account setting in force |
| `env` | `{}` | Explicit child environment entries layered over the subprocess seam's scrubbed parent environment |
| `permissionMode` | `trust` | One of five non-interactive permission modes; see [Permission modes](#permission-modes) |
| `approveMcps` | `true` | When true, pass `--approve-mcps` to auto-approve configured MCP servers. **Independent of `permissionMode`** |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | Escape hatch: appended verbatim to argv before the prompt. **Not validated** — see the warning below |
| `disposeGraceMs` | `3000` | Grace in milliseconds between termination tiers. Must be a positive finite number within the timer bound |
| `toolName` | `subagent_cursor` | Name of the tool this plugin registers itself (Host-level global). Must be **distinct** per instance when mounting two (see [The exposed tool](#exposing-the-tool)) |
| `c

`permissionMode` and `approveMcps` are not the same thing. `--force` (the `yolo` mode) covers shell and file edits but **does not cover third-party MCP servers**, so MCP auto-approval is a separate boolean rather than part of any permission mode.

> **`extraArgs` warning.** Whatever you put here enters argv unvalidated. Do not pass a flag that changes the output format (for example another `--output-format`): the parser would never see a `result` event and every run would fail. Do not put the prompt here either — the prompt is the final positional argument and the plugin appends it itself.
`disposeGraceMs` is validated at load time: a non-positive value, a non-finite value, or one above the timer bound fails plugin loading instead of surfacing at disposal.

Every capability flag is **false**: `agentOptions`, `agentPreset`, `outputSchema`, `depthLimit`. A child in another process cannot honour parent-enforced capabilities, so the shared service rejects requests needing them before `start` runs — never accepted-then-ignored.

Consequently depth governance belongs to this plugin: `startActivation`'s `request` carries **no** `maxDepth`, and the provider accepts no parent-imposed depth ceiling. To bound nesting of Cursor child tasks, constrain it in the prompt or at the CLI.

The same reasoning explains the other unsupported capabilities. Cursor's prompt is a single text entry point with no native channel for a schema, a tool allowlist, or a persona. Such constraints can only be stated in the prompt as prompt engineering, which is not a provider capability. -----

Five values, a mutually exclusive enum. Free-form combinations are not offered because their semantics are unverified. `--trust` is a base flag present in every mode, so the `trust` mode **appends nothing**.

| `permissionMode` | Appended CLI flags | Platform / behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `trust` (default) | none beyond base `--trust` | Works everywhere. Workspace writes are **auto-approved** |
| `safe` | `--sandbox enabled` | **macOS / Linux only.** On Windows the CLI exits 1 with empty stdout, and the plugin rejects it during `start()` |
| `yolo` | `--force` | Allow everything, including shell commands |
| `plan` | `--mode plan` | Read-only analysis and planning |
| `ask` | `--mode ask` | Read-only questions and explanations |

This is a measurement result, not a preference. On Windows, delegating "create a file and write OK":

| Mode | Flags | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `trust` | `--trust` | **22.8 s, exit 0, the file was really written**, `is_error: false`, normal `result` event |
| `yolo` | `--trust --force` | 23.2 s, exit 0, file written, normal |
| `safe` | `--trust --sandbox enabled` | **2.6 s, exit 1, completely empty stdout, zero `result` events** |

`safe` writes this to stderr: `Error: Sandbox mode is enabled but not available on this system. Sandbox requires macOS or Linux.`

In short, **`safe` cannot start at all on Windows.** Defaulting to it would make every delegation on such a host fail. A default that works beats a nominally stricter one that never runs.

Changing the default is not enough: an operator can still configure `safe` on Windows explicitly. Without a guard, the child runs for 2.6 s, emits empty stdout, and gets flattened into a generic `child run failed (error)` — unreadable as "sandbox unavailable".

So the plugin rejects the combination during `start()`, **before** spawning. The error names the macOS/Linux requirement and the alternatives (`trust`, `yolo`, `plan`, `ask`). Zero process cost, immediate failure, readable message.

> **Unverified:** on macOS and Linux, `safe` should work per the CLI's own error text, but it has **not been measured on either platform here**. Validate it yourself before relying on it: run a task that writes a file and confirm `stopReason` is `completed` and the file actually landed. -----

The completion notification carries Cursor's final answer text, or a stop reason plus a safe diagnostic.

**Copied into the parent Session:** the final answer, or the failure diagnostic.
**Not copied in:** Cursor's intermediate `assistant` messages, `thinking` reasoning, tool-call events, raw stderr, token usage, and workspace diff.

That is deliberate: `assistant` events are intermediate messages, a single run can emit several, and concatenating them would hand the model's reasoning back as the answer. See [pitfall 5](#pitfalls). -----
Everything below was measured on real runs. Read it before writing prompts or debugging.

readme.section: 1. The prompt must open with an imperative instruction
readme.text:
Tool-call counts for three prompt shapes:

| Prompt shape | Length | Tool calls |
|---|---|---|
| Core instruction only | 138 | **78** |
| Instruction first, constraints after | 394 | **92** |
| **"Working directory: ..." placed first** | 443 | **0** |

Lead with path or environment context and the agent treats it as a briefing, replies "working directory confirmed", and stops without calling a single tool.

readme.section: 1. The prompt must open with an imperative instruction
readme.text: **What this means for delegation:** the first sentence of a `subagent_cursor` task must be imperative ("read X and summarize it", "create Z in Y"). Working directory, date, time zone, and repository-root notes all go **after** the instruction. The plugin does not reorder prompts — it passes them through verbatim, so a bad order is the caller's bug.

readme.section: 1. The prompt must open with an imperative instruction
readme.text: The child's cwd already comes from `request.cwd`. **Do not restate the working directory in the prompt** — that is exactly the shape that produced zero tool calls.

Count `"type": "tool_call"` in `stream-json`, with subtype `started` or `completed`. Counting `tool_use` once made a successful run look like zero tool calls.

**For your own tooling:** when you parse CLI output by hand, or ask "did it actually do anything", count `tool_call`. The plugin's reader ([`src/wire.js`](src/wire.js)) counts the same way and only tallies those two known subtypes rather than guessing.

readme.section: 3. Terminal mojibake is a consumer-side problem, not a CLI one
readme.text: **The CLI's output is valid UTF-8** (measured). Mojibake comes from decoding it as GBK — the Windows console defaults to code page 936, so UTF-8 bytes read as GBK turn into garbage.

readme.section: 3. Terminal mojibake is a consumer-side problem, not a CLI one
readme.text: **What the plugin does:** it decodes stdout with `StringDecoder('utf8')` **per chunk** ([`src/wire.js`](src/wire.js)), never `chunk.toString()`. This matters because a UTF-8 sequence can straddle a chunk boundary; per-chunk `toString()` emits replacement characters, while `StringDecoder` holds the incomplete trailing bytes for the next chunk.

readme.section: 3. Terminal mojibake is a consumer-side problem, not a CLI one
readme.text: **For your own tests:** seeing mojibake in PowerShell does not mean the CLI is broken. Redirect the output to a file and read it as UTF-8, or set `[Console]::OutputEncoding` to UTF-8 first.

readme.section: 4. On Windows `cursor-agent` is a three-layer wrapper; the plugin bypasses it
readme.text:
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\cursor-agent.cmd` merely re-launches `powershell.exe`, which launches `versions\<newest>\node.exe` on `versions\<newest>\index.js`. That is `.cmd` → PowerShell → `node.exe`.

**This plugin spawns `node.exe index.js` directly.**

readme.section: 4. On Windows `cursor-agent` is a three-layer wrapper; the plugin bypasses it
readme.text:
- It never spawns a `.cmd`: Node cannot execute one without `shell: true`.
- It never uses `shell: true`: that hands the prompt back to `cmd.exe`, where `%VAR%` expands and `&` or `|` split the command — dangerous with any non-trivial prompt text and special characters.

readme.section: 4. On Windows `cursor-agent` is a three-layer wrapper; the plugin bypasses it
readme.text:
The side benefits are skipping PowerShell startup (roughly 300–800 ms per run), no quoting minefield, and argv passed through unchanged. Version-directory selection mirrors `cursor-agent.ps1`: a name matches `^\d{4}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}(-\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})?-[a-f0-9]+$`, and the newest date segment wins.

Note that `C:\Program Files\cursor\...\cursor` is the **IDE launcher**, not the CLI agent. Do not point `cliPath` at it.

One run emits several `assistant` events (3 in a measured "ls, then pwd, then summarize" run; other runs have been observed with 8) and exactly one `result`. Measured, `result.result` equals every `assistant` text concatenated with an empty separator.

So:

- Taking the last `assistant` alone drops earlier content (22% of it in the example above).
- Concatenating `assistant` events folds reasoning ("run `ls` first, then `pwd`") into the conclusion.

**What the plugin does: `output` is built from `result.result` and nothing else.** `assistant`, `thinking`, and `user` events never contribute. When `result` is missing (process killed, for instance) there is no fallback to thinking text — an `error` is preferable to half-finished reasoning.

**For your own scripts:** read the `result` line and ignore the rest.

- **The prompt travels as a positional argument and is length-bounded.** About 32 KB on Windows. An overlong prompt **fails outright rather than being silently truncated** — better than truncation, but put bulk material in a file and let Cursor read it instead.
- **`plan` and `ask` are read-only.** Do not expect work from them.
- **Cold start is slow.** 3–6 s measured, but `start()` does **not** wait for it: the run is published right after spawn, so the cold start shows up as `result` latency. Size timeouts accordingly.
- **Roughly 10K input tokens is the floor per delegation** (measured 9880 / 9883 fixed overhead). Very short tasks are not worth Cursor.
-----

readme.section: Differences from the official Codex provider
readme.text:
| Dimension | `dsh-subagent-codex` | This package (cursor) |
|---|---|---|
| Process / protocol | Codex app-server, JSON-RPC **bidirectional** (it must answer approval requests) | Cursor CLI `stream-json` NDJSON, **one-way** (stdout only) |
| Handshake | `initialize` → `initialized` → `thread/start` | None; a `system`/`init` event is only metadata, there is **no ready gate** (the run is published right after spawn) |
| Answer selection | final → partial → last unphased message | **Only `result.result`**, no fallback chain |
| Capability flags | All false | All false (same) |
| Human-in-the-loop approval | Per-request, declinable / cancellable | **No request channel**; fixed up front by `--trust` / `--force` / `--approve-mcps` |
| Mid-run steering | interrupt available | **None**; only killing the process |
| Continuation / resume | Unsupported | Unsupported (the CLI has `--resume`, but this plugin does not implement `resume`) |
| Cold start | A few hundred ms | **3–6 s** (measured 4.4 s / 5.8 s / 3.2 s) |
| Per-run token floor | Small | **~10K input tokens** |
| Child executable | Bundled platform payload | **Externally installed `cursor-agent`** (not shipped) |

readme.section: Differences from the official Codex provider
readme.text: The summary: Codex speaks a bidirectional protocol and can approve step by step; Cursor emits a one-way event stream and front-loads all authorization into startup flags. The latter is coarser, but simpler for unattended work — there is no "nobody answered the approval request, so it hung" failure mode. -----

<details>
<summary>Implementation details — click to expand</summary>

- **One delegation, one process, one chat.** Each run spawns a fresh `cursor-agent` and exits after a single prompt. No continuation, resumption, or pooling.
- **Native configuration is authoritative.** Login state, model defaults, and MCP configuration come from the Cursor CLI's own settings. The plugin only overrides an optional `model`, an explicit `env`, the permission mode, and MCP auto-approval.
- **Deliberately unattended.** Output is one-way and stdin is closed, so there is no reply channel. All authorization is fixed before startup.
- **Fail loud.** Configuration errors detectable at startup — missing CLI, a permission mode the platform cannot honour, an unusable cwd — throw from `start()` rather than surfacing later as a generic error.

1. **Validate and resolve.** `start()` runs `assertUsableCwd` on `request.cwd`, applies the platform guard (`safe` + `win32` throws), then `resolveCursorCli` locates `node.exe` + `index.js`. Resolution order: `cliPath` → `%LOCALAPPDATA%\cursor-agent\{index.js,node.exe}` → `versions\<newest>\{index.js,node.exe}`.
2. **Build argv.** `buildArgv` produces a fixed order:

```
   node.exe index.js -p --output-format stream-json --trust [--model m] [<mode flags>] [--approve-mcps] [<extraArgs>] <prompt>
   ```

The prompt is always the final positional argument; anything after it is swallowed into the prompt instead of parsed as a flag. A measured default-mode argv:

```json
   ["-p","--output-format","stream-json","--trust","--approve-mcps","Reply with exactly: PONG"]
   ```

3. **Spawn.** Through the shared `ctx.subprocess.spawn`, with `stdio.stdin = 'ignore'` (the prompt is positional, so stdin stays closed — which also stops the CLI blocking on a pipe nobody will write to), `cwd` from `request.cwd`, and `env` as the seam's scrubbed parent environment plus explicit entries. The returned handle shape (`stdout`/`stderr`/`done`/`terminate`/`waitForExit`) is validated right after spawn — an unexpected shape fails loudly with best-effort cleanup. The child's stderr is forwarded verbatim to the host stderr (`process.stderr.write`, pausing the child stream on backpressure) while only the last 8 KiB is rolled into memory for failure diagnostics.
4. **Read NDJSON.** stdout chunks feed `CursorStreamReader`; `StringDecoder` reassembles multi-byte sequences across chunks, lines split on `\n`, and each line is `JSON.parse`d. Lines that are not JSON objects are recorded as bounded noise (at most 5, for failure diagnostics) and skipped (the CLI interleaves banner and progress text), never fatal; a single newline-free line beyond 8 MiB fails stream framing. Startup failures (missing CLI, unusable cwd, spawn rejection, platform guard) **throw without publishing a run**; everything after publication is flattened into a `stopReason` and a safe diagnostic. -----

The unit tests use Node.js's built-in test runner. No build step and no real Cursor CLI are required: the DSH runtime packages are replaced by module-resolution hooks in `tests/_support/hooks.mjs`, and children are fake handles (a `PassThrough` stream plus a thenable `done`). Time advances only by microtasks — no sleeping, no network.

```bash
npm test                              # runs the package.json test script (Node's built-in test runner)
node --test "tests/**/*.test.mjs"     # equivalent: invoke the runner directly
```

Four files: `argv.test.mjs` (CLI discovery and argv order), `wire.test.mjs` (NDJSON framing and chunked UTF-8), `run.test.mjs` (run lifecycle and failure flattening), `index.test.mjs` (Config defaults, win32 guard, provider/tool registration). Current baseline: **all 114 test cases pass**.
> This repository has **no CI workflow**: the peer dependencies are private `@deepseek-ai` packages, so a hosted `npm ci` cannot work. Tests run locally (`npm test`). -----

- **One delegation, one process, one chat.** No continuation, resumption, pooling, or chat-id reuse. The tool description states plainly that the backend is single-shot: no mid-run steering, no follow-ups on the same chat.
- **No mid-run steering.** `--print` mode has no input channel (stdout one-way, stdin closed), so `sendMessage` is not implemented. Cancellation is terminal: it kills the process.
- **Child tokens never enter the parent Session.** The parent receives only the final answer or the failure diagnostic; intermediate messages, thinking, tool activity, stderr, usage, and workspace diff stay out. The child pays its own token cost.
- **Files already changed are not rolled back** on cancel or failure. There is no side-effect rollback and no wall-clock timeout. Under `trust` / `yolo`, Cursor may genuinely have written files and run commands, and those stay.
- **No `outputSchema`, `agentPreset`, `agentOptions`, `toolFilter`, or `persona`.** All capability flags are false; requests needing them are rejected before `start`.
- **The CLI must be installed externally.** This package ships no Cursor CLI and has no "fall back to the host CLI" path. A missing CLI is a startup error
